assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 subscription-manager package must be installed.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Note: If the system is not an internet connected system, this requirement is not applicable.

Verify that RHEL 9 subscription-manager package is installed with the following command:

$ dnf list --installed subscription-manager

Example output:

subscription-manager.x86_64          1.29.26-3.el9_0

If the "subscription-manager" package is not installed, this is a finding.
